Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: rtlpp_06892_combined.v

Read input: rtlpp_06892_combined.v · Open raw
module rtlpp_06892 (
  input               clk,
  input               rst,
  input               i_enable,
  input       [1:0]   i_wr_rdy,
  output  reg [1:0]   o_wr_act,
  input       [23:0]  i_wr_size,
  output  reg         o_wr_stb,
  output  reg [31:0]  o_wr_data
);

reg   [23:0]          r_count;

always @ (posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
  if (rst) begin
    o_wr_act        <=  0;
    o_wr_stb        <=  0;
    o_wr_data       <=  0;
    r_count         <=  0;
  end
  else begin
    o_wr_stb        <= 0;
    if (i_enable) begin
      if ((i_wr_rdy != 0) && (o_wr_act == 0)) begin
        r_count     <=  0;
        if (i_wr_rdy[0]) begin
          o_wr_act[0]  <=  1;
        end
        else begin
          o_wr_act[1]  <=  1;
        end
      end
      else if (o_wr_act != 0) begin
        if (r_count < i_wr_size) begin
          r_count   <=  r_count + 1;
          o_wr_stb  <=  1;
          o_wr_data <=  r_count;
        end
        else begin
          o_wr_act  <=  0;
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

endmodule
